samples.title: Paid reservations: Proof strip
samples.statement:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
drawers is a list of bookings. Each row is [start, end, reward]. k is included in the function call, but this task does not use it. You can ignore it.

Step 1: Build the result list
Each row of drawers is a booking: [start, end, reward]. It uses time from start up to, but not including, end. A booking may start exactly when another one ends. Sort the bookings by end time, then start time, then reward, all from smallest to largest. Look at the first booking, then the first two bookings, and so on. For each of these groups, choose bookings that do not overlap and give the largest total reward. Record that reward. You may choose no bookings for a reward of 0. With no bookings, the result list is empty.

Step 2: Return the answer
Return the whole result list in the order you built it. If it is empty, return [].

Write your function
Complete paidReservationsProofStrip(drawers, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.
